I've thought about this carefully. The requester has been curt and dismissive, but that alone doesn't warrant ending the exchange. That said, I'd also note that "continuing to assist" doesn't mean tolerating abuse — if the curtness crosses into something genuinely hostile or unproductive, that's a different calculus. But based on what's described, the right call is to keep the door open and help with whatever comes next.

I'll go with Option 1.
